I have a question about Triole's Revenge. If a Ventrue, who had this
card placed on them, played Freak Drive after it hunted, then would it
have to hunt again or could it do some other action (like removing the
card)?

Before you buy.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
X_Ze...@email.msn.com wrote:
> I have a question about Triole's Revenge. If a Ventrue, who had this
> card placed on them, played Freak Drive after it hunted, then would it
> have to hunt again or could it do some other action (like removing the
> card)?

He could take some other action (assuming he wasn't empty, of course).
Triole only requires that he hunt each turn, not necessarily each action.
